segments.title: 第52章 軍訓
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Era, Chapter 52: Military Training

"Hua Xiuxiu, come here, come here."

Hua Xiuxiu had just finished helping Li Luo sell belts at the entrance to the dormitory area and had rushed to the classroom when she heard Lin Yuan calling her from his seat.

"What's wrong?" Hua Xiuxiu, dressed in a green military training uniform, came over and sat down in the seat in front of Lin Yuan.

"I saw that the training uniforms didn't come with a belt." Lin Yuan feigned a casual look and handed a belt to Hua Xiuxiu's desk. "I happened to have an extra one at home, so I brought it for you."

Lin Yuan was a day student, so he hadn't received one of the free belts provided by Li Luo.

He had also just arrived at the classroom and was waiting for Hua Xiuxiu, so he hadn't noticed that every other student in the class had a belt.

When Hua Xiuxiu received the belt from Lin Yuan, she was momentarily stunned. "I have my own."

"Huh?" Lin Yuan was surprised. "You brought a belt with you to school?"

"Not exactly." Hua Xiuxiu shook her head and took out the belt Li Luo had given her. "The class monitor gave it to us for free. All the boarding students in our class should have one."

"Li Luo?" The mere mention of this guy made Lin Yuan's teeth ache, but upon hearing he had given belts to everyone in class, Lin Yuan couldn't say much, feeling only a bit awkward.

He looked at the belt he had just handed to Hua Xiuxiu, unsure whether to take it back or what to do.

"Thank you, anyway." Hua Xiuxiu didn't make things difficult for Lin Yuan. She picked up the belt he gave her, stood up, and carefully put it on. Then she picked up the extra one. "This extra one, if any other students in the class are missing one, they can use it."

Seeing Hua Xiuxiu put on the belt he gave her, Lin Yuan's face immediately lit up, and he nodded repeatedly. "Right, right, maybe some other students don't have one."

At that moment, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi also arrived on the third floor.

The two parted ways at the end of the corridor. After watching Ying Chanxi go upstairs, Li Luo walked into the classroom. He noticed the belt in Hua Xiuxiu's hand and couldn't help but ask, "Not putting it on yet?"

"I already did." Hua Xiuxiu lifted the hem of her shirt to show him the belt.

"Then why do you still have an extra one in your hand?" Li Luo asked, puzzled. "Did you grab an extra one just now?"

"You're the one who grabs extra!" Hua Xiuxiu glared at him, then said, "Lin Yuan brought it for me, so the one you gave me is extra."

"Oh, oh, got it." Li Luo smiled knowingly, looking at Lin Yuan and then back at Hua Xiuxiu, nodding in understanding. He then reached out and took the extra belt from Hua Xiuxiu's hand. "If you're not using it, give it to me."

"Take it, take it."

At that moment, it was exactly seven o'clock, and the school bell rang.

Kong Junxiang, also dressed in a military training uniform, walked into the classroom from outside.

Li Luo was just about to go back to his seat when he saw Kong Junxiang tugging at his own waistband.

Raising an eyebrow, Li Luo stopped and went back to the teacher's podium, asking Kong Junxiang, "Teacher, does your training uniform have a belt?"

"Nope." Kong Junxiang was taken aback for a moment. "What's wrong?"

He usually wore pants that didn't require a belt and lived in the teacher's dormitory provided by the school. His small wardrobe didn't have such a thing as a belt.

However, the military training pants at least had an elastic waistband, so they weren't unwearable. It was just that they tended to slide down after walking a lot, requiring him to hitch them up from time to time.

He had thought he could just make do for seven days.

But he didn't expect that Li Luo would now extend a hand and place a belt on the podium.

"I happen to have an extra one here. Teacher Kong, you can use it."

"Hmm?" Kong Junxiang was surprised. "You brought an extra one?"

"Yeah." Li Luo said with an innocent and guileless look. "I figured someone in class might be missing one, so I brought an extra."

Hua Xiuxiu: "..."

The vice class monitor, sitting in the front row below the podium, was speechless, thinking, *How can you say that with a straight face?*

But thinking about how this guy had given the entire class a free belt this morning, Hua Xiuxiu decided not to fuss with him over such a small matter.

"That's thoughtful of you. I'll just borrow it then." Kong Junxiang didn't think much of it, just assuming that Li Luo, as the class monitor, was being considerate.

It never crossed his mind that his own class monitor had made a huge profit selling belts at the dormitory entrance that very morning.

After watching Li Luo return to his seat, Kong Junxiang cleared his throat and addressed the whole class. "Starting at eight o'clock this morning, we will officially begin our military training. There are a few things I need to emphasize again..."

...

The late August weather was still hot enough to turn the sports field into a giant steam room.

Class Eight's Drill Instructor Zhang was thin and stood ramrod straight in front of the formation, watching the new students stand at attention.

After a morning of training and lunch, the afternoon session had begun.

The initial novelty of military training had vanished, replaced by sore muscles and sweat drenching their bodies.

"You, step out of the line!" Drill Instructor Zhang patrolled the area and suddenly pointed at Wei Chun, who was on the side, shouting loudly.

Wei Chun was clearly stunned.

He had been so exhausted just now that he had secretly relaxed his leg. The drill instructor's shout sent a jolt through his entire body.

But looking at Drill Instructor Zhang's eyes, Wei Chun pressed his lips together and silently took a step forward.

"I told you before, no fidgeting without permission."

"As punishment, run one lap around the track!"

Wei Chun swallowed, wanting to say something, but his mouth moved and nothing came out.

In that brief moment, seeing that he didn't start running immediately, Drill Instructor Zhang chuckled and then shouted again, "Where is the class monitor?"

"Here, instructor." Li Luo raised his hand from within the ranks.

"You must shout 'present'!" Drill Instructor Zhang corrected. "Where is the class monitor?"

"Present!"

"What about the sports committee member?"

"Present!"

"Present."

"Why so quiet? Didn't you eat lunch?" Drill Instructor Zhang walked up to Yan Zhusheng. "Louder!"

"Present!"

Yan Zhusheng didn't have the delicate nature of some girls and immediately corrected herself, shouting earnestly.

"Very good." Drill Instructor Zhang smiled again, then asked, "Do you have a vice class monitor?"

"Present!" Hua Xiuxiu shouted loudly from the ranks.

"Good!" Drill Instructor Zhang clapped his hands. "The four of you, step out together!"

Saying that, Drill Instructor Zhang walked over to Wei Chun. "Running alone is too lonely, right? Now let the four of them run with you. Go on."

As soon as he said that, Wei Chun immediately lowered his head, bit his lip, and clenched his fists.

But just then, Li Luo had already run to Wei Chun's side and thrown an arm around his neck. "Let's go, it's just one lap."

"Two laps," Drill Instructor Zhang glanced over and added.

"Yes, sir!" Li Luo didn't argue and responded loudly, then quickly dragged Wei Chun off to run laps.

"On the first day of military training, drill instructors always like to establish their authority. Just get used to it," Li Luo consoled him as they ran, speaking from experience.

"He could have just run by himself. Now he's dragged the four of us into it," Hua Xiuxiu, who wasn't very athletic, couldn't help but mutter under her breath.

"That's exactly the effect the drill instructor wants." Li Luo glanced at Hua Xiuxiu and said calmly, "When you start complaining about your classmate, he's achieved his goal. So, say less of this kind of stuff during military training."

Yan Zhusheng and Zhu Yufei didn't seem to have any objections.

Zhu Yufei was naturally athletic; running two laps was just a warm-up for him.

What was unexpected was that Yan Zhusheng, with her long legs, didn't seem to be out of breath after running two laps either.

After the five of them finished running and returned to the formation, at around three in the afternoon, the chief drill instructor announced a twenty-minute break in the middle of the sports field.

Li Luo glanced toward the school wall at the edge of the field and saw a familiar figure waving at him.

He immediately patted Zhu Yufei on the shoulder and shouted to a few other boys, "Come with me, I've got something good."
